title: Magellan radar finds metallic snow on Venus

tellings.quote: in fact, I was at NASA when the Mellan probe was mapping Venus using radar.

plain: A physicist named Kevin Knuth, who worked at NASA, the US space agency, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that he was at NASA in the 1990s when the Magellan probe was mapping the planet Venus with radar. He says the radar found what looked like metallic snow on the Venusian mountains. He brings it up to show that strange findings turn up in space data.
